arrival_grid.definition: strict planning rate through exactly 2x, with strict conservative hurdle inserted

assumptions.natural_continuous_batching: Little's Law applies to decode-resident sequences: mean instantaneous decode batch L_decode=lambda_completed*W_decode. Queue wait and prefill do not inflate L_decode.
assumptions.no_interactive_slo: No hard completion-time acceptance threshold is imposed. Product owners must decide whether the observed background completion distribution is usable.
assumptions.service_parameter: S is normalized GPU service seconds/request at full batch c. Under the linear sensitivity, batch-step time=S*c/358, batch decode wall=S*c, and capacity=1/S.
assumptions.synchronized_pooling: Poisson arrivals, identical 358-token completions, gated start at c; full batches are active only for a duty cycle and do not imply average resident concurrency c over billed wall time.

decision.c12: Preferred robust logical-capacity point: positive peak-context headroom near 0.83 GiB, still requiring actual allocator and endpoint telemetry.
decision.c14: Conditional allocator-sensitive point: positive logical peak-context headroom only about 0.07 GiB; reject if actual peak reserved crosses the bound.
decision.not_proven: No measured service time, batch distribution, queue stability, completion usability, failure rate, or commercial endpoint result is claimed.
decision.unusable_region: For any externally chosen mean decode-residence ceiling T, natural c requires aggregate arrival lambda>=c/T. If this fails and synchronized pooling's observed completion distribution is unacceptable, that c is unusable at that traffic. Any service row with lambda*S>=1 is unstable.
decision.why_nonempty: At the strict planning hurdle, natural c12/c14 requires mean decode residence of about 16.7/19.5 seconds; synchronized pooling can instead expose full active batches with explicit fill delay. These durations are not ruled unusable because the campaign permits background latency tradeoffs.

merge_formulas.batch_distribution_component_projection: sum_M(decode_batch_step_count[M]*component_step_seconds[M])/completions, only when identity-matched component timings exist for every observed M; otherwise the measured endpoint service controls
merge_formulas.component_plus_residual_pre_endpoint_scr: identity_matched_component_seconds_per_request + 0.1646315388888889; never substitute this for measured endpoint service
merge_formulas.little_law_check: mean_decode_resident ~= completed_arrival_rate*mean_decode_residence_seconds after accounting for interval censoring
merge_formulas.observed_service_seconds_per_request: gpu_active_seconds/completions; also report metered_seconds/completions for economics

later_endpoint_telemetry_merge_contract.typed_merge_rule: Return credible only when identities match, all completed requests are accounted, queue drift is nonpositive within a preregistered sampling uncertainty, lambda*S<1, Little's-Law residual is explained by censoring, memory stays within 44.704 GiB, and the externally chosen background completion/reliability acceptance passes. Otherwise return unusable with the failed field, or none when required telemetry is absent.

memory_capacity.boundary: Logical FP8-KV accounting only; allocator fragmentation, workspaces, captured graphs and actual peak reserved bytes remain endpoint telemetry requirements.
